condition: pityriasis rosea herald oval patch followed by nonpainful scaly trunk spots
level_rationale: Developing 1 oval pink patch on the chest 2 weeks ago followed this week by an itchy spreading rash of smaller oval scaly spots across the back in a 26-year-old adult describes an acute generalized papulosquamous trunk eruption warranting an outpatient general-physician visit to confirm the clinical diagnosis, exclude secondary syphilis or tinea corporis, and prescribe symptomatic antipruritic care rather than unguided self-care or emergency care, whereas a single oval chest patch from 2 weeks ago shrinking to a barely visible pale mark today reflects spontaneous skin resolution requiring only routine self-care.
